description: This file contains Swift unit tests for the CommandResolver component of the OpenClaw project, validating command construction logic for different configurations and environments.

classes.name: CommandResolverTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the CommandResolver logic, focusing on command construction and environment handling.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a new UserDefaults instance with a unique suite name for testing.

methods.name: makeLocalDefaults
methods.description: Creates and configures UserDefaults for local connection mode with specific connection settings.

methods.name: makeProjectRootWithPnpm
methods.description: Sets up a temporary project directory with a pnpm executable for testing command resolution.

methods.name: prefers open claw binary
methods.description: Test that verifies the command uses the 'openclaw' binary when available.

methods.name: falls back to node and script
methods.description: Test that verifies fallback to node and script path when the openclaw binary is not available.

methods.name: prefers open claw binary over pnpm
methods.description: Test that verifies the openclaw binary is preferred over pnpm when both are available.

methods.name: uses open claw binary without node runtime
methods.description: Test that confirms the command uses the openclaw binary directly without falling back to node.

methods.name: falls back to pnpm
methods.description: Test that verifies the command uses pnpm when openclaw binary is unavailable.

methods.name: pnpm keeps extra args after subcommand
methods.description: Test that extra arguments are preserved after the subcommand in the command list.

methods.name: preferred paths start with project node bins
methods.description: Test that the preferred search paths start with the project's node_modules/.bin directory.

methods.name: builds SSH command for remote mode
methods.description: Test constructing an SSH command for remote connection mode, including target and identity.

methods.name: rejects unsafe SSH targets
methods.description: Test that unsafe SSH target strings are rejected and return nil.

methods.name: config root local overrides remote defaults
methods.description: Test that local configurations override remote default settings when constructing commands.
